title: content/gear/gear.json
description: 08 §1 — the 24 base items, nested by slot: six slots with four families each, every family carrying the §1.1 axis that fixes its stat bias and, at SS rarity, its set. Content transcription only: no stat numbers live here (those are drops.json's slot coefficients and rarity multipliers), and no rolled instance does either — a GearInstance is server state, not content. Nested rather than flat so 'four families per slot' is the document's shape; a flat array would also repeat `slot` four times per slot, which the shared duplicate-identity invariant reads as four rows declaring the same thing.

slots.description: 08 §1 — exactly six, one per equipment slot, each carrying its four families.

families.description: Exactly four, one per family axis. Four axes x six slots is the 24-piece roster and the reason a full set is six pieces.

id.description: 08 §7 authors GEAR_WEAPON_BLADE; the remaining twenty-three follow that GEAR_<SLOT>_<FAMILY> spelling.

familyAxis.description: 08 §1.1's four axes. The axis IS the SS set identity — there are exactly four sets, one per axis — which is why no setId is authored on an item or stored on an instance.
